factualSources.claim: City of Leesburg Municipal Utilities provides potable water service sourced from the Floridan Aquifer, serving residential and commercial meters across Lake County.
factualSources.source: City of Leesburg Public Works & Water Utilities Department

factualSources.claim: Lake County Florida features karst limestone topography and porous sandy soils that cause subterranean water leaks to migrate downward rather than pooling on the surface, making electronic acoustic detection essential.
factualSources.source: Florida Geological Survey (FGS) Karst Topography & Aquifer Vulnerability Studies

factualSources.claim: Leesburg municipal water meters are equipped with low-flow indicator dials and digital transmitters that rotate during continuous, unmetered downstream domestic leakage.
factualSources.source: City of Leesburg Utility Meter Operations Manual

factualSources.claim: Residential and commercial building codes in Central Florida follow the Florida Building Code Plumbing Volume for slab-on-grade foundation pipe penetrations and pressure testing.
factualSources.source: Florida Building Commission & Lake County Building Division
